What Is the Best Method for Cleaning Carpets Springfield VA?

September 24, 2021
Table of Contents

If you have carpet cleaning Springfield VAon your list of things to learn more about, you are in the right place because this article will explain the different types of carpet cleaning. There are certainly a few different carpet cleaning methods in Springfield VA, so learning something about the types of method in carpet cleaningwill help you make the right choice.

When it comes to figuring out the best carpet cleaning method in Springfield VA, the truth is that different situations will require a unique solution. So there is not really one single best way to clean carpet in Springfield VA.

For this article we will tell you about the different types of carpet cleaning and when is the best situation to use them. After reading this you will have a better understanding of different types of carpet cleaning and you will be able to make an informed decision when you need to.

Steam Cleaning

The method of cleaning carpets with steam is one of the most common methods of professional carpet cleanersbecause it works great in many situations. The only time that steam cleaning is not appropriate is on extra tough stains or when a carpet or rug is dry clean only.

Steam cleaning is great if you or your family have sensitivities or allergies to soaps or chemicals, because it only uses steam to clean the carpet. Some people can be really bothered or made ill by the chemicals in dry carpet cleaning solutions, so they should definitely use steam cleaning on their carpets.

Steam is great for killing any bacteria that might be living in the carpet fibers. They can’t take the heat and will die pretty fast when exposed to the hot steam.

The steam helps to lift dirt out of the carpet fibers and does a great job of getting most stains, dirt and debris out of the carpet. For neglected carpets, steam cleaning can be a great way to restore them to looking as good as possible.

It is said that a steam carpet cleaning will even help to eliminate odors left by pet urine. After potty training a pet can be a great time to bring in a steam cleaner as you can get rid of all the odors that were created by your little friend, who now knows how to go in the appropriate place.

A drawback of the steam carpet cleaning method is that it can require a period of drying afterwards where you should not walk on the carpet at all, possibly overnight. If you need to be using your carpet or don’t have space to move your furniture to for several hours, you might consider another method for your carpet cleaning.

Some people even say that steam cleaning can be harsh on carpets if it is done too often. The heat of the steam might be too strong for some fibers, so that’s why it’s very important to consult some cleaning professionals for safety procedures. Same when planning remodeling services, always consult professional remodeling contractorsfirst.

Hot Water Extraction

This method of carpet cleaninguses a pressurized solution of hot water and soap to get deep and hard at a stain, then a powerful vacuum sucks up the dirty hot water. The pressure used in this method really agitates the carpet fibers and most dirts and soiled on material are knocked right off.

Hot water extraction may be the strongest method for getting super stuck on stains out of a carpet. The pressure of the water can be pretty high, and so there is not much that can actually stay on the carpet fiber after getting blasted.

With the amount of pressure being used, it is advised to only use hot water extraction as often as you absolutely need to. Some carpet cleaners will even want to try other methods before going for hot water extraction

The amount of water used for this method makes it the slowest drying, and therefore the most likely to help bacteria or fungus to grow in a carpet. With proper drying techniques, this should not be a problem, but you want to make sure you have an experienced carpet cleaner working for you if they are performing this method. .

Dry Carpet Cleaning

To be totally honest, maybe this method should be called low moisture carpet cleaning, it is not totally dry. It uses chemicals that absorb all sort of stains and odor causing agents from the carpet.

The chemicals are applied as a powder and then worked into the carpet fibers by a special dry carpet cleaning machine. After fifteen minutes of waiting for the chemicals to work their designed process they can be vacuumed out.

This method of carpet cleaning really gets stains out well. The chemicals used in the process have come a long way, they are truly effective to lift stains out of fibers.

A great advantage of dry carpet cleaning is that it uses so little moisture that it requires the least drying time of all of the carpet cleaning methods. A dry cleaned carpet can be walked on in as little as thirty minutes.

This makes it a good option for areas that get walked on by the public and you can’t possibly close off for long. The fast drying time can also make it easier to schedule the moving of furniture off of the carpet, as it can all be done in a short time span.

Do It Yourself Cleaners

There are many products available to help you clean your own carpet. Some of these products work very well and if you follow the directions well you can get excellent results.

The problem with doing carpet cleaning yourself is that it is really easy to mess it up and ruin your carpet or need to call a professional carpet cleaner anyway. It just makes more sense to hire professionals who have lots of experience and all the right tools to get your carpet cleaned well. Like when planning to do a remodeling in your home, it’s much better to hire professionals like this remodeling company.

You want to maintain your carpet the proper way so that it can last as long as possible. Not only are new carpets expensive, they take a lot of work where you will be seriously inconvenienced for a while.

With regular maintenance by professional carpet cleaners, your carpet will last a lot longer and you can keep enjoying it more because it will be cleaner.
